predictions.articleTitle: Šiauliai vs Minija Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Can Minija Crack Top-Flight Defense?

possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw anchored on Šiauliai's first-leg 2:0 away win and four-match competitive unbeaten run against top-tier and playoff opposition (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Šiauliai defend a 2:0 aggregate cushion against second-tier Minija.

spf.comment: Covers both a clinical 1:0 transition win by Šiauliai and a managed 1:1 draw, as aggregate protection removes any need for Šiauliai to chase the match if level.

over_under.comment: Supported by the 53.6% Poisson Under 2.5 baseline, Šiauliai's 0.88 A Lyga goals-per-match output, and Minija's failure to score in two recent top-tier fixtures.

btts.comment: Aligns with the primary 1:0 projection as Minija have been shut out in both top-flight tests while Šiauliai prioritize compact defensive containment.

score.comment: 1:0 reflects Šiauliai punishing late visiting urgency on transition, while 1:1 accounts for the modal Poisson scoreline if Minija's pressure yields one goal.

goals.comment: Two total goals represent the highest Poisson density bin (25.5%) across 1:1 and 2:0 scripts, with one goal capturing a cautious 1:0 home win.

bqc.comment: Expects a tight first-half deadlock before Šiauliai either capitalize on second-half spaces (Draw-Win) or manage a level draw to full time (Draw-Draw).
